units.source_text: 母亲不由得把胳膊缩了回来，这当儿，

en.t: The mother could not help pulling her arm back, and just then,

units.source_text: 抓住她手指的孩子吧嗒一声摔倒在地上，脑袋沉重地撞在砖地上，哭不出声来。

en.t: the child who had been holding her finger fell to the ground with a thud, his head striking heavily against the brick floor, and he could not even cry out.
